name: 2024-2c-recuperatorio-parcial1
title: Tetris Prototype (pieces and movement)
description: A simplified Tetris on a walled board of at least 4x5 whose state is checked through a string representation. In this reduced scope the student models the game and the five tetrominoes (chosen by a random number), the tick that moves the current piece down, moving it left and right, and the rule that pieces cannot leave the board.

design.notes: The five piece shapes invite five subclasses or five sets of offsets, the random number must be mapped to a piece without a case statement, and the board rendering to strings plus the anchor-position convention must be designed from nothing.
